title: Fresh checkouts lack the wallpapers referenced by both themes
description: Found during the workspace ownership audit of commit 759613c. Both theme JSONs reference original artwork, and Theme.qml uses the original Deep Night image as fallback. git ls-files lists only the generated deep-night.png and mountain-dusk.png wallpaper assets. The referenced originals are excluded locally by .git/info/exclude and are absent from a fresh checkout. Choose distributable assets or a documented local override without publishing third-party artwork by accident. Acceptance: every shipped theme and fallback source resolves to a distributed file, or an explicit local-only setting with an available shipped default. Live wallpaper readiness and theme swaps remain unverified.

title: UI ownership leaks across monitors and hidden surface instances
description: Found in the workspace ownership source audit. EdgeScene.handlesArmed uses the global modal instead of occupancy of its own monitor. keyboardGrab has no surface or screen owner, retains all rail stacks and follows the focused keyboard window. Hidden LauncherSurface instances retain editor secrets and can schedule late focus work while the global modal name remains launcher. Dashboard and Performance destructors can disable detailed sampling demanded by another monitor. Source citations and exact scenarios are recorded in docs/BACKLOG.md and /tmp/opencode/workspace-scope-audit.md. Acceptance: owner-keyed input retention, local handle suppression, retired launcher work and aggregate sampling demand hold across monitor migration. Native symptoms remain unverified. Not this task: visual redesign or hardware service replacement.

comments.author: qs_m4rk
comments.text: The same launcher source audit confirms submitNetwork() clears networkPassword only after connect() returns true (LauncherSurface.qml:659-660). NetworkService has rejected-start paths at 104-110, while spec/07-launcher.md:128-129 requires clearing even a rejected submission. Include this secret-lifetime path in the named launcher repair. The audit did not read actual credential values or submit network operations.

comments.author: qs_m4rk
comments.text: Detailed-sampling ownership is source-repaired in the first refine-quiet-luminous-desktop slice: permanent PanelSurface instances aggregate watchDetails demand and Dashboard/Performance destructors no longer write polling. Native overlap remains unverified. Monitor-local handle suppression, ownerless keyboard retention and launcher/editor/secret lifetime gaps are still open, so this audit task is not closed.

title: Finish Quiet Luminous desktop touchups
description: For the owner using the existing two-monitor Hyprland desktop: make the current shell deliberately finished, readable and wallpaper-matched without rebuilding the rail or menus. Preserve vertical app captions, the 60px left band, 40px rail, five panel tabs, accepted rollout mechanics and hardware/service policy. Acceptance: coherent violet surface ladder; 12px other frame edges agree with paint/input/reservation geometry; equally sized DD/MM above HH/mm; stable responsive upper-panel footprint and usable overflow; one readable mirrored CPU/RAM handle; quiet rounded popup rows with unchanged actions/lifetimes; owned input/editor/sampling behavior across monitor migration. The owner explicitly authorized batch implementation after a detailed written plan. No automatic tests, validation, captures, desktop input, production restart, hardware writes, push or archive. Implementation and source review are not runtime/visual acceptance. Scope and steps: openspec/changes/refine-quiet-luminous-desktop/.

title: Refine Quiet Luminous desktop
description: Implement the source-prepared change in openspec/changes/refine-quiet-luminous-desktop. Follow its tasks.md phases and preserve the explicitly retained rail/menu/action policy. Review and commit on repository main without push or archive. Generic workflow checks are waived because project rules require a separate explicit request. Native behavior, screenshots and owner visual acceptance remain separate open evidence.

comments.author: qs_m4rk
comments.text: First item source-prepared: stable responsive panel, bounded static overflow, model-tab scrolling retained, instance-owned detailed sampling, violet palette/shared ladder, 12px ordinary frame with retained left band/rail, equal-size date/time and mirrored fixed CPU/RAM handle. Performance normal/short stories use isolated samples and a fixed battery record; all other preview tab contents remain deliberately unloaded until their safe fixtures are built. Luna high source review found one live-UPower fixture leak, confirmed/fixed, then corrected review reported zero findings. Reports: /tmp/opencode/desktop-touchup-first-luna.md and /tmp/opencode/desktop-touchup-first-luna-corrected.md. Parent reviewed the source paths. No tests, validation, captures, input, restart or hardware writes. No runtime/visual acceptance. Phase 3.5, phases 5/6 and combined/final owner review remain open in tasks.md.

title: Owner review of desktop touchups
description: Final test-it/acceptance gate, intentionally not run automatically. After the owner requests checks, inspect one named item at a time: stable Performance-panel geometry and overflow; clock/frame and moving resource handle; supported themes/outputs and suppression; rounded notification replacement/retirement/action routes; owner-qualified password input, hidden launcher retirement and detailed-sampling demand on monitor migration. Preserve no-takeover and no-hardware-write constraints. The epic remains open until requested evidence and owner acceptance exist.

title: README: add screenshots and a short GIF of the desktop
description: what: the public README has no image of the shell; the old spec/references screenshots were third-party and were removed before publishing, and the two original wallpapers were replaced by generated gradients. how: capture the frame band and rollouts (rail, notifications, OSD, top panel, launcher, session) on a clean workspace with no private windows or notifications, e.g. grim + slurp for stills and wf-recorder for a 10-20 s GIF; store under docs/assets/, link at the top of README; replace the deleted spec/references with own captures if the visual gates still need references. why: a reviewer cannot run a Wayland shell from a link, so without an image they cannot see what it is. needs: the user's live Hyprland session and judgment (the workbench capture flow is user-driven by design).
